description:
DMX lighting controller that records, stores, and plays back lighting shows.

DMX Core 100 records lighting shows from your lighting software, stores them, and plays them back on schedules or on demand. Playback can be triggered from the built-in web interface, schedules, the Web API, or external protocols such as OSC, MQTT, MIDI, and Stream Deck. Output goes over sACN, Art-Net, and KiNet. This desktop edition runs the same software as the DMX Core 100 wall-mounted appliance.
Improved recording stability during system updates; better handling of interrupted restarts and locks.
